王野笑呵呵的说：“师父，我明天要去东北，得十来天呢，得再拿几本书。”

平三卓笑骂道：“你个臭小子对赵老头是真好呀，千里迢迢给他去找药。”

王野嬉皮笑脸的说：“这不是师父身体硬朗吗，要是您也是有伤在身我也给您去找药。”

平三卓呸了一口说：“放屁呢，我好着呢，而且肯定比赵老头活的久。”

王野赶紧说：“对对对，您活的久肯定是您活的久。咱现在是不是先进屋呀，我这儿的几本书还有好多不懂的呢。”说完拉着小老头就进书房了。

一下午一老一少就在书房里一问一答，好不和谐。就连师娘进来王野也只是打了个招呼。看着这师徒俩师娘也笑呵呵给他们沏了壶茶就出去了。

五点多王野就回家了，这次直接拿走了十本书。王野并没有留在平三卓家吃饭，他还有一个任务呢。

到了家王野跟秦婉说了一声，等到王铁柱回来后骑着车就又出去了，这时的王野无比怀念手机，这要是有手机那用这样溜腿儿呀。

骑着车背着包，王野一路都在想怎么道歉。突然王野停下车子，精神力进入空间，找到了那盒都快蒙尘的巧克力。

取出巧克力直接放进包里，开开心心的向大院骑去。这里的门卫已经认识王野了，只是简单的询问就放行了。

王野直接去了陈家，到了门口大门敞开着。王野推着车子直接进了院子。这个院子王野不是第一次来，可是这次心情太忐忑了。

王野深呼了一口气喊道：“有人在家吗？”

在屋里的陈洛兮听见了王野的声音猛的就站了起来，在王野没来的时候，这姑娘已经出去好几趟了。气的陈近岳实在看不下去了，躲进了书房。

韩雅芝一把拉住女儿说：“兮兮，交朋友不是这样子的。”

缓缓站起来拉着女儿出了门。院中的王野刚要继续叫人，就看见韩雅芝带着陈洛兮出来了。王野赶紧上前一步打招道：“伯母好，洛兮好。”

陈洛兮跃跃欲试的要回应王野，韩雅芝手上微微用力，捏了一下陈洛兮的手说：“小野来啦，先进屋。”

说完就领着王野进了客厅，在示意王野坐下后说：“小野，你和兮兮先聊聊，我去给你们拿点儿喝的。”

王野起身说：“伯母不用客气，我坐会儿就走。”

韩雅芝示意王野坐下，就转身去了书房。王野是第一次这样和一女生独处，真是尴尬他妈给尴尬开门，尴尬到家了。

王野微闭眼睛深深的呼了口气，猛的睁开眼睛好像要押赴刑场一样，从包里拿出那盒巧克力递给陈洛兮结结巴巴的说：“那个，那个洛兮，昨天......昨天的事儿对......对不起啊。”

陈洛兮是第一次见这个样子的王野，在他眼里王野是一个帅气，务实，幽默有时欠儿欠儿的男生。可是这个害羞的大男孩又让她觉得那么可爱。

陈洛兮接过巧克力，还是没忍住噗呲一声笑了出来。王野好不容易酝酿好的情绪被这一笑全都笑没了。王野皱着眉头说：“你笑什么呀，我还没说完呢？”

陈洛兮强忍着笑意说：“你继续说，我不笑了。”

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Master, I am going to the Northeast tomorrow. It will take about ten days. I need to get some more books."

Ping Sanzhuo laughed and scolded: "You brat are so kind to Old Man Zhao. You traveled thousands of miles to find medicine for him."

Wang Ye said with a playful smile: "Isn't this the master's strong body? If you are also injured, I will find medicine for you."

Ping Sanzhuo took a sip and said, "You fart, I'm fine, and I will definitely live longer than Old Man Zhao."

Wang Ye hurriedly said: "Yes, yes, you will definitely live longer if you live longer. Should we go into the house now? I still don't understand a lot of the books here." After that, he pulled the little old man into the study.

All afternoon, an old man and a young man were asking and answering questions in the study, which was so jarring.Even when the master's wife came in, Wang Ye just said hello.Looking at the master and apprentice, the master's wife also smiled, made them a pot of tea and went out.

Wang Ye went home after five o'clock, and this time he took away ten books.Wang Ye did not stay at Ping Sanzhuo's house for dinner, he had another mission.

When they got home, Wang Ye talked to Qin Wan, and after Wang Tiezhu came back, he rode out again. At this time, Wang Ye missed his mobile phone very much. If he had a mobile phone, he would use it to get around like this.

While riding a bicycle and carrying a bag, Wang Ye was thinking about how to apologize.Suddenly Wang Ye stopped the car, entered the space mentally, and found the box of chocolates that was almost covered in dust.

He took out the chocolate and put it directly into his bag, then happily rode towards the compound.The guard here already knew Wang Ye and let him go after a simple inquiry.

Wang Ye went directly to Chen's house, and when he arrived at the door, the door was open.Wang Ye pushed the car directly into the yard.This was not the first time Wang Ye came to this courtyard, but this time he felt too uneasy.

Wang Ye took a deep breath and shouted, "Is anyone home?"

Chen Luoxi, who was in the room, stood up suddenly when she heard Wang Ye's voice. Before Wang Ye came, the girl had already gone out several times.The angry Chen Jinyue couldn't stand it anymore and hid in the study.

Hanyazhi grabbed her daughter and said, "Xixi, this is not how to make friends."

He slowly stood up and pulled his daughter out of the door.Wang Ye in the courtyard was just about to continue calling people when he saw Hanyazhi coming out with Chen Luoxi.Wang Ye quickly stepped forward and said hello: "Hello, aunt, hello Luo Xi."

Chen Luoxi was eager to respond to Wang Ye, but Hanyazhi squeezed Chen Luoxi's hand with a little force and said, "Xiao Ye is here, come in first."

After saying that, he led Wang Ye into the living room. After gesturing for Wang Ye to sit down, he said, "Xiaoye, you and Xixi talk first, and I'll get you something to drink."

Wang Ye stood up and said, "Auntie, you're welcome. I'll sit down and leave in a while."

Hanyazhi motioned to Wang Ye to sit down, then turned and went to the study.This was the first time for Wang Ye to be alone with a girl like this. It was so embarrassing that his mother opened the door to him. It was so embarrassing.

Wang Ye closed his eyes slightly and took a deep breath. He opened his eyes suddenly as if he was about to be escorted to the execution ground. He took out the box of chocolates from his bag and handed it to Chen Luoxi. He stammered, "Um, Luo Xi, yesterday... I'm sorry for what happened yesterday."

This is the first time Chen Luoxi has seen Wang Ye like this. In his eyes, Wang Ye is a handsome, pragmatic, humorous and sometimes erratic boy.But this shy big boy made her feel so cute.

Chen Luoxi took the chocolate and couldn't help laughing.Wang Ye's hard-working emotions were all wiped out by this smile.Wang Ye frowned and said, "Why are you laughing? I haven't finished speaking yet?"

Chen Luoxi suppressed her laughter and said, "Keep talking, I won't laugh anymore."
